summary: Show miner identity, current Pass, local block evidence and verified block income in the status dashboard
details: Miner progress panels show the configured reward address and current candidate Pass at the top, with candidate energy, level and BTC evaluation height beside mining state.

Chain rows distinguish the network head from a local seal evidenced by recent container logs and canonical RPC checks. Block income includes verified miner issuance and miner fees; it is not account balance or cumulative income.

The optional mining.activity JSON projection uses bounded probes, a block-hash cache and failure backoff. Reorgs withdraw orphaned-block income; unavailable optional observations do not change readiness or mining authorization.
No protocol, database, service configuration or network identity changes are required. Existing chain releases without the economics RPC display income as unavailable.
